validationErrors.descriptionTooShort: Description is too short — write at least 40 characters

rulingGenerator.title: Preliminary Ruling
rulingGenerator.subtitle: Describe the incident and MONSIF will retrieve the statutes and precedents that bear on it, then propose a preliminary ruling — and check its own citations against what it retrieved.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain what happened in detail: the parties, when and where, the sequence of events, and any available evidence or reports…
form.minLengthHint: Write at least {min} characters for an accurate analysis.

upload.extracted: Text read from {fileName}. You can edit it before submitting.

errors.unsupportedFileType: Unsupported file type. Only .txt is accepted
errors.docxUnsupported: Word files are not supported: the API has no extraction endpoint. Open the file and paste its text, or save it as .txt
errors.emptyFile: The file is empty or contains no text

loading.title: Analysing your case…
loading.subtitle: MONSIF is retrieving the relevant statutes and precedents, then deliberating over them. This takes about a minute and cannot be shown as it goes.

result.chargesHint: Including the ones ruled out — the rejected charge is as much a part of the reasoning as the chosen one.
result.legalBasisHint: What the model was given to reason from. Open one to read it in full.
result.classifierHint: A statistical guess made before the model saw anything, shown for comparison. It does not decide the outcome.
result.disclaimer: This is an AI-generated preliminary ruling for guidance only. It is not legal advice and not a court judgment.

verification.ungroundedTitle: Some citations could not be verified

issues.unsupportedQuotes: Quotes not found in the article they cite
issues.precedentMismatch: Precedents whose articles disagree with the chosen charge
issues.penaltyDoubt: Penalties that may not come from the cited article

verification.mismatchDetail: Case {caseNumber} turns on article {precedentArticles}, while this ruling settled on {chosenArticles}.

blocked.title: The analysis engine is unavailable
blocked.description: No language-model key is configured on the server, so no ruling can be generated.

noMatch.title: No usable ruling was produced
noMatch.description: The engine ran but could not reach a prediction it was willing to stand behind. Nothing is shown rather than an unsupported ruling.
noMatch.hint: Try rephrasing with more detail: the acts committed, the standing of each party, and the resulting consequences.

error.title: Analysis could not be completed
error.description: Something went wrong contacting the analysis engine. Please try again.
error.salvagedTitle: What was retrieved before the failure
error.salvagedHint: Retrieval succeeded; only the ruling itself failed. These are the statutes and precedents that were found for your facts — no ruling is attached to them.

discrimination.title: Telling similar articles apart
discrimination.hint: Two articles were close enough to be confused, so the engine wrote down the questions that separate them and answered each from your facts.

notification.successBody: MONSIF finished analysing the case you submitted.
notification.errorTitle: The ruling could not be generated
notification.errorBody: Something went wrong while analysing your case.

redaction.redactedTitle: Name removed from the published judgment

search.hint: Describe what you are looking for in your own words — a few words or a full scenario. Enter to search, Shift+Enter for a new line.

errors.queryTooShort: Write at least 3 characters to search
errors.queryTooLong: Search text exceeds the maximum length

states.errorDescription: Something went wrong contacting the server. Please try again.

lawSearch.title: Laws
lawSearch.description: Browse the corpus law by law, read a law as a book, or describe a situation to retrieve the articles that apply to it.
lawSearch.searchPlaceholder: e.g. deliberate assault causing more than ten days off work…

card.repealedNote: This article has been repealed and is no longer in force.

empty.title: No articles here
empty.description: No article matches the selected filters. Try clearing a filter.
empty.searchDescription: No article matched your description with enough confidence. Try rephrasing it with more detail, or clear a filter that may be excluding results.
empty.lawsDescription: No law matches the selected collection or name. Try clearing a filter.

law.articleSearchPlaceholder: Find an article by number or text…
law.articleSearchLabel: Find an article in this law

empty.title: No articles here
empty.description: No article in this law matches the selected filters.

book.loading: Loading the full text of this law — the whole law is fetched at once so it reads without interruption.

links.chooseArticle: This reference names {count} articles — choose one:

notification.successBody: MONSIF finished retrieving articles for your query.
notification.errorBody: Something went wrong while retrieving articles.

caseSearch.title: Precedents
caseSearch.description: Browse the judgments corpus by the crimes it covers, or describe the facts of an incident to retrieve the past judgments that resemble it.
caseSearch.searchPlaceholder: e.g. the accused broke into a house at night and took a sum of money…
caseSearch.coldStart: The precedents index has not been loaded yet, so the first search takes about a minute while the models are prepared. Later searches take a few seconds.

detail.title: Case {number}
detail.redactionNote: Names were removed from this judgment before publication; the parties appear as neutral labels.
detail.noSections: This judgment carries no text sections.

empty.searchDescription: No judgment matched your description with enough confidence. Try adding detail, or widen the scope to “Broad”.
empty.browseDescription: No judgment matches the selected filters. Try clearing one.

notification.successBody: MONSIF finished retrieving judgments for your description.
notification.errorBody: Something went wrong while retrieving precedents.

contractTemplates.title: Contract Templates
contractTemplates.description: Browse the templates by category, or describe the contract you need. Then fill in the blanks and print or export it.
contractTemplates.searchPlaceholder: e.g. a lease for a commercial shop…
contractTemplates.coldStart: The templates index has not been loaded yet, so the first search takes a moment while it is prepared.

filters.suggestHint: Adds one model call and needs a Groq key; without one the search fails rather than degrading.
filters.nameLabel: Filter templates by title or keyword

suggestion.title: The model suggests: {subject}
suggestion.noneTitle: The model found none of these suitable

editor.fieldsHint: Each blank is labelled with the sentence it belongs to — the templates carry no field names of their own.
editor.noFields: This template has no blanks; it can be printed as it is.
editor.incompleteWarning: Some blanks are still empty. They will print as ______.

empty.searchDescription: No template matched your description. Try saying what the contract is for in plainer terms.
empty.browseDescription: No template matches the selected category or filter. Try clearing one.

summarization.title: Case Summarizer
summarization.subtitle: Paste a case and get its key sentences back, along with the fields that recur in every judgment. Instant, and entirely on the server's own rules — nothing is generated.

form.textPlaceholder: Paste the full text of the case: the facts, the parties, the evidence, and the ruling…
form.minLengthHint: Paste at least {min} characters — a summarizer needs sentences to choose between.

fields.title: Fields found
fields.hint: Each value below is a literal span from your text, matched by rule rather than inferred. An empty row means the text did not state it.

summarization.error: The text could not be summarized. Please try again.

classification.title: Crime Classifier
classification.subtitle: Describe what happened and a multi-label classifier names the offences it recognises. Instant, and independent of the retrieval features.

form.factsPlaceholder: Describe what was done, by whom, and how: the acts, the circumstances, and anything seized…
form.minLengthHint: Write at least {min} characters — a one-line description gives the classifier almost nothing to weigh.

result.title: Offences recognised
result.disclaimer: These are the labels that crossed the model's decision threshold. It reports no confidence per label, and the list is neither a charge sheet nor legal advice.
result.emptyDescription: Nothing crossed the classifier's threshold for these facts.
result.emptyHint: That is an answer, not a failure. Try describing the acts themselves in more detail — what was done, how, and with what.

classification.error: The facts could not be classified. Please try again.
